notes: VCA306: fix BLANK silent thermal prints. A never-shown (show:false) print window skips compositing, so webContents.print({silent:true}) captured a blank page (dad's KP307 fed empty strips while the Windows dialog printed fine). Fix: the reused print window now uses paintWhenInitiallyHidden:true + backgroundThrottling:false, and printReceipt forces two animation frames after load so the page has actually PAINTED before the silent print. Main-process change → auto-relaunch. Needs on-hardware verification.
